name: Potrace
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: Single-colour bitmap tracing to SVG paths; stable but unreleased since 2019
summary: Command line tool that traces a black and white bitmap into smooth vector outlines, writing SVG, PDF, EPS or other formats. Colour or greyscale input must be thresholded first (ImageMagick or built-in options); output is single-colour paths. Its strength is clean, well-regarded curve fitting from a small, stable native binary.
use_when: Turning a scanned logo, sketch or silhouette into SVG paths for stroke-draw or morph animation
Single-colour vectorisation scripted in a shell pipeline after ImageMagick thresholding
avoid_when: Multi-colour artwork: Inkscape's trace handles colour
The source is already vector: use SVG and SVGO
GPL-2.0 is a problem in a distributed product: avoid bundling the binary
license: GPL-2.0-or-later (commercial Potrace Professional is separate; recheck before bundling)
notes: 2026-10-26: Homebrew shows licence GPL-2.0-or-later; upstream offers a separate commercial Potrace Professional.

assessment.rationale: Latest release 1.16 dated 2019-09-17, older than 36 months by the brief's rule, but the tool is feature-complete and still packaged by Homebrew. GPL-2.0-or-later. Keep: no maintained neighbour in the catalogue traces bitmaps.
